prediction.clinical_reasoning: the patient's gastrointestinal symptoms are indicative of malabsorption, which can lead to vitamin and mineral deficiencies including iron, resulting in anemia. Confirmatory investigations would include serologic testing for celiac disease antibodies such as anti-tissue transglutaminase (anti-TTG) or endomysial antibody (EMA), and further evaluation of iron status through complete blood count (CBC) with peripheral smear examination and serum iron studies.
